title: Round-trip bashDeny in the policy config DTO (option a)
commit_message: feat(policies): round-trip bashDeny in the policy config DTO
decision: option (a): declare bashDeny?: string[] on PolicyConfigDto so the global whitelist pipe round-trips it. Option (b) (silently drop) rejected: guardForAgent/resolveBashDeny still read config.bashDeny, and the editor owns whole-config PATCH writes.

implementation.added_field: bashDeny?: string[] with @IsOptional() @IsArray() @IsString({ each: true }) + @ApiProperty({ type: [String], required: false })

discriminating_observable.description: Before fix the global ValidationPipe whitelist strips config.bashDeny; stored config has NO bashDeny key. After fix it does. hasOwnProperty(bashDeny) is the discriminator.
discriminating_observable.before_fix: storedConfig has no bashDeny key (hasOwnProperty === false); bashDeny=[123] resolves instead of 400
